Auto svg conversion with accessible names enabled

```ruby title="Ruby"

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert_with_accessible_names('<p><svg aria-label="Name"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>', true, HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(inline_data_media: 'AltTextOnly', tier_strategy: 'auto'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
